meta.scope: NS-14 official registrations that mention ECAP telemetry and clinical outcomes

trials.registered_primary_outcomes: Composite endpoint success at 3 months
trials.registered_secondary_outcomes: Leg/back VAS changes and at least 80% overall pain reduction at 3 months, among nine registered secondary outcomes
trials.boundary: ClinicalTrials.gov has aggregate results posted, but no downloadable per-patient ECAP waveform/outcome table or linkage key; IPD=NO. Article request wording and registry IPD=NO disagree.

trials.registered_primary_outcomes: ECAPs measured by the Evoke SCS system at 12 months post-implant
trials.registered_secondary_outcomes: No registered secondary outcome
trials.registered_other_outcomes: Change in pain, PROMIS-29, PROMIS-10 Global, POMS, PGIC and therapy satisfaction at end of trial and 1/3/6/12/18/24 months post-implant
trials.boundary: ECAP and pain outcomes are registered in one trial and aggregate results are posted, but no released participant key or linked waveforms are identified; IPD=NO.

trials.registered_primary_outcomes: Feasibility assessed by enrollment at 2 weeks
trials.registered_secondary_outcomes: Acceptability assessed by survey at 2 weeks
trials.registered_other_outcomes: Correlation of ECAP peak-to-peak signals with programming parameters and correlation of ECAP with pain relief, both at 2 weeks; stability and intraoperative reliability also registered
trials.boundary: A future anonymized deposit is promised; no exact-ID Zenodo accession was found on 2026-09-25. Registered ECAP/pain correlation does not prove patient-linked raw data are accessible.

trials.registered_primary_outcomes: Percent change in VAS pain at 3 months post-implant
trials.registered_secondary_outcomes: Device/procedure adverse events and ECAPs measured by the Evoke SCS System through 60 months post-implant
trials.boundary: ECAP and pain are registered in one follow-up study; no participant-level waveform/outcome package or linkage key is provided. IPD sharing is NO.

trials.registered_primary_outcomes: Change in ECAPs measured by the Evoke SCS System through 6 months post-implant
trials.registered_secondary_outcomes: Change in VAS pain, PROMIS-29+2 and PROMIS-10 Global Health through 6 months post-implant
trials.boundary: Registered ECAP and clinical outcomes do not establish downloadable per-patient data, a linkage key or independent prognostic validation. IPD sharing is NO.

trials.registered_primary_outcomes: Change in VAS pain intensity from baseline to 12 months; trial-end and 1/3/6/12-month measurements registered
trials.registered_secondary_outcomes: No registered secondary outcome
trials.ecap_role: The intervention description specifies Medtronic Inceptiv closed-loop DTM SCS with ECAP-feedback adjustment.
trials.boundary: Interventional estimated cohort, not released participant data; IPD sharing remains undecided. Distinct diabetic-neuropathy device study, not an EVOKE report.

trials.registered_primary_outcomes: Change in 0-10 numerical pain rating at baseline and 3/6/12 months

trials.lead_sponsor: The Leeds Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust
trials.condition: Chronic abdominal pain in title; conditionsModule lists generic Pain

trials.ecap_role: ECAP-controlled closed-loop SCS appears in the primary-outcome wording; intervention description lists thoracolumbar radiographs and does not specify the controller.

trials.registered_primary_outcomes: Pain level on a 0-10 scale and evoked response amplitude for ECAPS and SSEPs, all at Visit 1 (up to 2 hours)

trials.ecap_role: Feasibility of recording ECAPs/SSEPs and evaluating them as feedback signals; study terminated for budgetary issues.

trials.cohort_overlap: not_assessed; this NCT registration is not evidence of an independent cohort relative to other SCS registrations.

trials.registered_primary_outcomes: Proportion of subjects with reduced overstimulation sensation under closed-loop versus open-loop SCS, in-clinic testing (1 day)
trials.registered_secondary_outcomes: None identified
trials.ecap_role: ECAP is in the official study title and eligibility requires clear, measurable ECAPs; the registered endpoint compares stimulation sensation, not pain intensity.
trials.boundary: Aggregate results are posted. The API record provides no affirmative IPD sharing statement or linked participant-level ECAP/outcome table. This is an acute stimulation-tolerance comparator, not a longitudinal pain outcome study.
trials.cohort_overlap: not_assessed; no cross-record participant linkage is reported.

trials.registered_primary_outcomes: Reduction in overstimulation sensation at 30 days from device activation
trials.registered_secondary_outcomes: Responder rates for overall pain, low-back pain and leg pain at 3 months
trials.ecap_role: Protocol names Inceptiv with Neuro Sense; the posted results section identifies the subset with clear, measurable ECAPs and reports outcome groups. ECAP linkage is therefore evidenced only at aggregate results-description level in this record.
trials.boundary: Aggregate results are posted and IPD=NO. No participant-level ECAP and pain linkage or export is available from this registration. Do not infer the Neuro Sense algorithm's exact ECAP data structure from its product name.
trials.cohort_overlap: not_assessed; this record does not establish a distinct cohort from other SCS registrations.

trials.registered_primary_outcomes: Pain by Visual Analog Score at baseline, day 1, day 7 and day 14

trials.cohort_overlap: not_assessed; no evidence here establishes independence from other SCS studies.

trials.registered_primary_outcomes: Overall pain intensity and low-back/leg or neck/arm pain intensity at 1, 6 and 12 months

trials.cohort_overlap: not_assessed; shared technology or indication does not prove independent participants.

trials.registered_primary_outcomes: Change in intra-epidermal nerve fiber density from baseline to 12 months

search_update.source: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 GET /studies, six saved query.term routes; pageSize=100, countTotal=true, followed nextPageToken until exhaustion. Union of returned registry IDs 458; local keyword prefilter is only triage, not manual screening of all IDs.

queries.query_term: spinal cord stimulation AND pain AND outcome

screened_not_added.reason: SCS and ECAP are registered, but the only registered outcome found is ECAP change; no pain/function clinical outcome is specified.
SCS and ECAP microvolt measurement are registered; no clinical pain/function outcome is listed.
SCS and ECAP/APM programming are registered, but outcomes are APM use/time-to-program rather than clinical pain/function; aggregate results are posted.
Open-loop transcutaneous stimulation for respiratory and hand function after spinal cord injury; no ECAP-controlled analgesic SCS endpoint.
ECAP collection is the sole registered primary outcome; no patient pain/function outcome.
Closed-loop SCS and NRS pain are registered, but ECAP sensing/telemetry is not explicitly specified in the accessible protocol; retained as a contextual lead pending device-method confirmation.

Panorama registration compares automatic with manual SCS control and includes patient pain outcomes, but the accessible protocol does not explicitly name ECAP measurement or telemetry; retain as clinical closed-loop context without treating it as linked ECAP/pain data.

existing_record_correction.finding: Registry places VAS pain in primary outcomes, Ashworth/SF-36/medication/EQ-5D in secondary outcomes, and ECAP morphology/current/conduction velocity in other outcomes; corrected contradictory boundary and audit field.

search_update.boundary: Two additional registrations were added: CIPRESS explicitly links ECAP-controlled CL-SCS intent to longitudinal NRS pain outcomes but has no results/IPD release; NCT07780032 is a distinct RLS indication with device ECAP and only secondary PROMIS pain interference, not an analgesic efficacy result. Query counts are returned-hit counts, not eligible cohorts. Keyword triage and bounded manual checks do not close systematic screening or establish linked patient data. Later dated refresh and owner access remain open.

previous_record_recheck_2026_09_25.finding: All 14 status and lastUpdatePostDateStruct values matched the audit. NCT02924129 and NCT04319887 had hasResults=true; their data availability values were corrected to distinguish aggregate results from IPD=NO and unestablished patient linkage.
